interpretation: The fully independent host-resource panel has ample host-geography and sampling-geometry support but sparse LepTraits wing coverage. Adult-dispersal and host-resource effects therefore cannot be separated confirmatorily in this panel without changing the frozen species domain or importing a new wing-trait source. The host-resource-geography primary estimand proceeds unchanged.
future_boundary: Any future adult-dispersal comparison requires a separately frozen external wing-size source and a new response-blind support census; it cannot be added after genetic outcomes from this follow-up are opened.
